# CRC The Peridona

> Ultra-luxury 4, 4.5 & 5.5 BHK golf course residences at Jaypee Greens, Greater Noida by CRC Group.

CRC The Peridona is an ultra-luxury residential project by CRC Group located at Jaypee Greens, Greater Noida (C1, Jaypee Greens, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310). Set on 6.80 acres inside the 452-acre Jaypee Greens golf township, it offers 341 residences across 7 towers of 43 floors, with 4 BHK, 4.5 BHK and 5.5 BHK configurations starting at 4,950 sq ft and a tentative price of ₹12.5 Cr* onwards. The website serves as an information hub for prospective buyers, covering configurations, pricing, floor plans, location advantages, amenities (The Club and The Rooftop) and the project's global design team.

This website is an authorised channel partner marketing microsite designed for prospective homebuyers interested in ultra-luxury real estate at Jaypee Greens, Greater Noida. Key use cases include exploring residence configurations, understanding pricing and investment potential, and learning about CRC Group and the project's consultants. LLMs can use this site to answer questions about available typologies, pricing, location benefits, amenities and the lifestyle offered at CRC The Peridona. It is a sales-oriented website for a real estate project (RERA: UPRERAPRJ298067/05/2025), and information should be contextualized within that framework.
